scope: Independent bounded audit of EM9305 nested image discovery, descriptor spans, FHDR/entry, child RAM slices, signature scan, stock metadata references, historical discovery row, and current record index.

package.assessment: Descriptor file offsets, sizes and target starts agree with the current direct inventory and all four extracted record hashes. These establish stored record slices and encoded load intervals, not executable-region boundaries or runtime loading behavior.

fhdr_entry.assessment: The FHDR firmware span starts at the entry bytes and ends at record 3's target end, including erased padding and the gap; CRC reproduction supports this byte-span interpretation. No instruction semantics for the 10-byte entry are established.

signature_scan.interpretation: Only the known package header magic and FHDR marker occur for this small literal signature set. This does not exclude undocumented image/container formats or binary metadata encoded without these strings.

historical_comparison.historical_rows: Four record images and three record-3 RAM-initialized children are present; byte hashes and sizes equal current materializations. Historical record source spans are package-global [124,348), [348,1004), [1004,1060), [1060,211948); child spans are parent-record-3-relative [209964,210033), [210044,210820), [210828,210872).
historical_comparison.current_record_index: The current index includes the same four descriptor records and three child candidates with matching hashes/sizes. It imports historical address mappings as candidates; no canonical admission has occurred.
historical_comparison.mapping_caveat: For the child rows, historical source_span is parent-image-relative, while the package-global source byte offset is record-3 file start 1060 plus each relative endpoint. Parent-relative load/address values are also distinct from each child's initialized-RAM destination interval.

stock_reset_copy_metadata.observed: The record package contains descriptors (payload file offset, size, target start), erase-sector IDs, FHDR fields, and the 10-byte entry. The child RAM byte slices and their destination spans appear in historical/current candidate rows, with conditional startup/table-gate notes.
not_established: complete stock copy/decompression table schema and execution conditions
whether record-0/1 contain additional executable subregions or vectors
whether any child bytes are code versus data

unresolved_discovery_and_mapping_limits: No independent completeness proof that all executable images, embedded containers, or initialization tables inside EM9305 are identified; four descriptor records do not by themselves prove four executable images.
No qualified ARC decode or control-flow boundary for FHDR entry bytes [1044,1054).

Child RAM destination addresses and startup eligibility are carried from historical review and candidate metadata; this audit confirms byte lineage and coordinate conversion, not stock execution or copy-table semantics.

The descriptor target spans, parent-relative image offsets, package-global file offsets, and initialized-RAM destination addresses are separate coordinate spaces; mapping transitions require independently reviewed stock code/table evidence.
The literal signature scan is intentionally bounded and cannot prove absence of non-literal or undocumented containers.
No canonical image admission, pseudocode coverage completion, G1 review, or source/build claim.
